svg.title: Bounded reply delivery
svg.desc: The execution and connection deadline remains unchanged. Connected reply waiting allows a fixed 100 ms to receive a complete failure. Success still requires the complete reply by the execution deadline; every reply must arrive by the delivery cutoff. Late success remains uncertain and must not trigger an automatic retry. Existing blocking writes are unchanged, so this does not claim a hard whole-call wall-time bound.
